places.name: Agra
places.summary: The marker uses Agra Fort as a modern city reference. The marker makes no claim about the exact site of Shivaji’s detention.

events.title: Escape from Agra
events.summary: The Jaipur correspondence reports that Shivaji had escaped custody. The letters and later accounts carry different levels of detail about the escape. The map marks Agra and leaves the return itinerary open.

events.title: Coronation at Raigad
events.summary: Raigad served as an administrative and ceremonial centre. The ICOMOS evaluation describes palace and market facilities, rainwater harvesting and administration at the hill fort.
